quoteMode.title: Instant or RFQ
quoteMode.body: A type can quote instantly only once its calculator has shipped, and a given spec only when a factory's prices cover it; everything else goes to RFQ.
quoteMode.confirmInstantBody: Customers see instant prices for {name} ({code}) wherever a factory's prices cover the spec.
quoteMode.confirmRfqBody: Customers must ask for a quote for {name} ({code}) in every case.
quoteMode.failed: Could not change the quote mode

import.forbidden: You cannot import or export the catalogue
import.rules: One workbook, one sheet per table, row 1 is the headers; references use codes, never internal ids.
import.errorsBody: Fix them in the workbook and upload again; nothing is imported while any row is invalid.
import.confirmBody: Adds {create} and changes {update} rows, exactly as previewed.

articles.title: Title
articles.excerptHint: Shown in lists and search results
articles.slugHint: Lower case, digits and hyphens; the URL
articles.seoPageHint: Title and description for search engines
articles.deleteBody: Removes {title} from the site and the system. This cannot be undone.

errors.title: A Thai title is required
errors.slug: Use lower case, digits and hyphens only
errors.summary: Not saved yet; check the marked fields

structural.title: Structural design requests
structural.rfqBody: When a fee applies it is quoted through a service RFQ; enter that RFQ's reference
structural.deliverBody: Upload the finished dieline (DXF, PDF, AI or SVG) for Prepress to approve
structural.wrongType: {name} is not a dieline file we take
structural.approveBody: The delivered dieline has been checked and can be made
structural.approveNote: Once approved it can be published as a library style
structural.publishBody: Link this request to the style code imported into the library; the customer is told
structural.baseCodeInvalid: A style code looks like PK-XX-00

intakes.title: Dielines from factories
intakes.description: Structures partner factories offer to the library: compare them with what exists, approve them as a new style or a template, or reject them
intakes.matchBody: Open this offer's DXF (download it above), pick the closest style and adjust its sizes until the lines agree; within 0.5 mm it is a match
intakes.pdfBody: This offer is a PDF: download it, compare it by eye, then approve or reject it. The page lays over DXF only
intakes.approveBody: Import it as a new library style, or as a fixed-size template of an existing one
intakes.asRecipeBody: Imported as a recipe through the library import (match it first)
intakes.asTemplateBody: Used as a fixed-size template of the style named, under the factory's permission
intakes.baseCodeInvalid: A style code looks like PK-XX-00
intakes.matchFirst: Match it to a library style before approving it as a new style

matcher.hint: ASCII DXF: lines, arcs, circles and polylines
matcher.unreadable: No lines could be read from this file (a binary DXF, or blocks only)
matcher.overlayLabel: The library style laid over the factory's file
matcher.legend: Solid: the library style · dashed: the factory's file
matcher.buildFailed: The style cannot be built at these sizes — adjust them
matcher.deviation: Largest deviation {max} mm · mean {mean} mm (accepted ≤ {tolerance} mm)

cases.approved: Approved: the story shows on the home page

images.title: Images of {name}
images.intro: The first photo is the cover customers see on the card. A new upload becomes the cover in place of the reference image; shown to customers once its scan is clean
images.drop: Drop PNG / JPEG / WebP images or
images.wrongType: {name} is not PNG, JPEG or WebP
images.orderHint: Drag to reorder, or use the arrows. Removed files are kept under the retention policy
images.rendersLeft: A photograph is in, but {count} reference image(s) remain in the gallery

options.title: Options of {name}
options.intro: Materials, finishes, coatings, ink colours, die-cuts, assemblies, print types and patterns the customer may pick, one default per kind. Saving replaces the whole list.

patterns.title: Patterns of {name}
patterns.intro: In display order; factors are indicative until the calculator fixes them.

reference.title: Starting price of {name}
reference.intro: The calculator configuration (one quantity) the product card's “from” price is quoted at; checked against the product type's calculator and recomputed at once.
reference.hint: As the storefront price request of this product type
reference.clearLabel: Remove the configuration (the card shows no starting price)
reference.invalid: The JSON must be a readable object.

attributes.title: Attributes of {name}
attributes.intro: One value per attribute, from that attribute's values.

colours.title: Palette of {name}
colours.intro: Colours as #RRGGBB, each once, in display order.

fonts.title: Fonts of {name}
fonts.intro: The fonts this template may use; saving replaces the whole list.

setDesign.title: Use a design for {name}
setDesign.intro: The current version of a staff-authored design becomes what customers start from.
setDesign.hint: The id (UUID) of a design the team authored

flutes.title: Flute types of {name}
flutes.intro: The flutes this pattern matches; saving replaces the whole list.

geometry.title: Geometry of {name}
geometry.introFolding: The condition each slot (dw dl nd nl nw aux_f aux_f10) of the pattern and its parts reads, and the die-cut blank at each standard size.
geometry.introCorrugate: The conditions of slots i k m (read by W) and j (read by W ÷ L).
geometry.blankInvalid: Choose the size and give DW and DL above 0.
geometry.blankDuplicate: A standard size is listed twice.

products.title: Products showing “{name}”
products.intro: The FAQ shows on the chosen product pages; saving replaces the whole list.

bands.title: Bands of {name}
bands.intro: Bounds inclusive (lower ≤ value ≤ upper), never overlapping, read in order; applies to the next quote.
bands.order: The upper bound must not be below the lower.

readiness.more: Showing {shown} of {count} — the rest appear as these are done

types.title: Product types and pricing mode
types.intro: A type that prices instantly turns “Ask for a price” into “Add to cart” for every product of that type at once. Switch the mode on the product types page
types.ready: {count} type(s) have their calculator shipped but still ask for a quote — sign off and switch them to instant

hints.referenceOnly: Every image here is a reference image; upload a photograph and it becomes the cover
hints.noImage: Customers see an illustration; upload one in the product's images dialog
hints.noPhoto: The card shows the rendered dieline; upload one in the storefront tab
hints.quoteOnly: The product type is in quote mode, so customers ask for a quotation
hints.notActive: Draft or inactive, so not on the storefront
hints.notPublishable: No variant passes the publication checks; see the readiness tab
hints.hidden: Hidden by curation; never published until unhidden
